name: link-preview
blurb: Link that shows a website or image preview on hover, with spring-based motion and cursor tracking.
description: Radix HoverCard-based link preview that displays a screenshot (live or static) with spring-animated entrance. Preview translates based on cursor position within the link.
use_when: Rich link previews in documentation, blogs, or social feeds that need smooth spring physics.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; requires hover. External API dependency (microlink.io) may introduce delays.
a11y: Link is keyboard-focusable and semantic; preview appears on hover only.
